newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - BellSouth raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BellSouth raised to buy.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan Securities Inc said it upgraded BellSouth Corp to buy from market performer and set a 12-month price target of $45 a share.
-- said raised the earnings estimate for 1997 to $2.80 a share from $2.76 due to expectations of continued strong revenue and earnings growth.
-- said BellSouth should sustain earnings growth of about 10 percent over the long term.
-- said BellSouth is best run and best positioned of the regional bell operating companies.
